title: Prove hosted project counts and unavailable recovery after deployment
text: The count implementation is landed, but its deployed proof is pending. Compare the hosted switcher and Billing with each organization’s member-visible active Projects inventory at desktop and 390px; include backlog-only and locally adopted projects, retired exclusion, separate organizations and member permissions. Exercise engine_project_count_unavailable, unknown instead of zero, retry and organization-admin connection recovery, and continued universe switching. PLAT-227 owns the internal deployed proof and acceptance; linking that item does not complete teaching or live verification. workbench-cues/desired-01 remains candidate with exact recipe and live delivery unproved.
